narr: Widespread street flooding occurred across the City of Houston as the collision of two boundaries resulted in the development of near-stationary strong thunderstorms. Additionally, frequent lightning strikes resulted in some property damage.
ev: Numerous roads were impassable due to floodwaters across the Houston area, especially in and around the West University Place and Galleria areas. Many vehicles were stalled due to the rapid rise of water levels.
lsr: SEVERAL VEHICLES FLOODED DUE TO FLOODING.
